annotation_proposals.append_comment: Provisional descriptive name. ECX context, two stack slots RET8; first UTF16-wrapper slot is unused, second is draw section. Reads context+EC/F0. Two code-unit loops measure and emit unsigned glyph+12 advances times context+1D8 with x87 float spills; no LF/CR break or pair kerning. Width is trunc_i64(context+20*double960) lowDWORD, then unsigned conversion. Modes1/2 center/right; others start0. Font height uses unsigned low16; first glyph binds material slots0/1 once. Geometry/resource lifetime and optional child UI are external. docs/FONT_LAYOUT_BOUNDARY.md;660 bytes match PE.

behavioral_findings.kerning: No pair-dependent metric lookup in the selected placement and ellipsis loops; no claim about every engine subsystem.
behavioral_findings.text_encoding: 16-bit code units, null-terminated; no surrogate pairing or shaping in inspected loops.
behavioral_findings.singleline_lf_cr: Neither causes line break; selector special records still apply.
behavioral_findings.wrapped_lf: Scan boundary included in emitted interval.
behavioral_findings.wrapped_spaces: Scanner multiplies advances by scale; emitted spaces use unscaled natural/justified space spacing.
behavioral_findings.wrapping_unbroken_word: No accepted space can cause inclusion of overflowing code unit.
behavioral_findings.justification: accepted_space_count-1 divisor; zero count guarded, one not guarded.
behavioral_findings.line_metric: context+114 compares emitted-line unscaled nonspace sum plus chosen space increments, not necessarily final x.
behavioral_findings.height_query: Normalized extent or signed font height divided by720; no vertical-scale multiplier.
behavioral_findings.ellipsis: Per-code-unit trunc_i32 then low16;3-dot reserve also trunc/low16, allowing tiny-target wrap.
